items.title: Alphonse Picou Interview, 1958-04-04
items.q: Or Jack Carey? I don't remember.

ctx.x: Now, what kind of a part did the violin play? Something like the clarinet or the lead? No, the lead. They always played just the straight balloting? The lead. The lead. Yes. Did you like working with a violin in a band? Yes, it did. That's why it's so little. A band. For what I think played. Yes. I was wondering, when was the first time you heard Tiger Rag played by a dance band? Can you remember who was the first one to play it or when you heard it about? No, I don't.
Or Jack Carey? I don't remember.

I don't remember. I was going to ask a bit more about your clarinet. What make is your clarinet? Is it a... Algar. Algar system. I mean, is it made in France or... Yeah, I remember. Yeah, one is in France. You don't remember the maker of it now. Is it Buffet or who made it? It has that peculiar... Oh, no, I got that bar. I forgot that bar. That's a hard name for France. It's a hard French name. Yeah, French name.
